paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: (left) and (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve .
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models in the LLaMA-2 family on CoLeG-R (%) across various scales, with results shown for models LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R (%) ranging from 0 to 80, while the horizontal axis lists the model scales. Each model has four bars representing different training conditions: "no SFT" (light blue), "+ SFT on D₀" (light orange), "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" (light purple with diagonal stripes), and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (solid pink). For all three model scales, performance generally increases with the addition of SFT data, with the highest CoLeG-R scores observed for the largest model, LLaMA-2-70B, particularly under the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" condition, where it reaches approximately 83%. The chart suggests that both scaling up the model size and expanding the SFT dataset contribute to improved performance.
